notes: Vaulty upgrade: he now answers LIVE questions from the worldstate feed — when Baro Ki'Teer is back (he lands Fri Oct 23 at Strata Relay), current events, Nightwave challenges, active fissures, today's Sortie, day/night cycles and the latest hotfix.

Vaulty knows much more: modding doctrine, Rivens (including the temporary Riven-trading shutdown), credits/endo/relic farming routes, focus schools, amps, forma and potatoes, and playstyle frame picks (tank, support, speed, spy).
When Vaulty honestly doesn't know, he now says so and offers one-tap 'Research this' buttons — Warframe Wiki search and web search on your exact question — instead of a dead end.
Fixed: Vaulty was missing his guide brain on 11 pages, 'where do I farm Kuva' answered with Nova's farm location, and 'what is Steel Path' returned a build list instead of an explanation.
